responsibility: Declares the TILEPro builtin opcode namespace as an enum of target intrinsics and special operations, covering arithmetic, SIMD-like byte/halfword operations, loads/stores with cache variants, special-register access, fences, prefetches, and network send/receive primitives. The backend uses these stable identifiers to register, look up, and expand target builtins in tilepro.c without hard-coding names throughout the implementation.
